name: Galazeth Prismari
description: Founder Dragon of Prismari who had the idea of founding Strixhaven at the epicenter of the snarls.

description_citations.text: "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Galazeth founds Strixhaven with an idea and is first to leave it to its own devices.
timeline.quote: The founding of Strixhaven was initially Galazeth's idea, yet he was also the first to leave the university to its own devices.

citation.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Galazeth Prismari proposes that the five dragons found Strixhaven University at the epicenter of the snarls.
timeline.quote: Galazeth Prismari had the idea for the five elder Dragons to found Strixhaven University at the epicenter of the snarls

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Mystic Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Galazeth Prismari founded the Prismari college at Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: It was founded by the elder dragon Galazeth Prismari
